lines.serbian: Petak je uveče. Napolju pada sneg.
lines.croatian: Petak je navečer. Vani pada snijeg.
lines.english: It's Friday evening. It's snowing outside.

lines.serbian: Maja i Filip ne idu nigde.
lines.croatian: Maja i Filip ne idu nikamo.
lines.english: Maja and Filip aren't going anywhere.
"Ludo!" (Its name here means "Man, don't get angry".)
Maja rolls the die. A six!
Filip rolls the die. A one.

lines.serbian: Posle pola sata Maja ima tri figure u kućici.
lines.croatian: Nakon pola sata Maja ima tri figure u kućici.
lines.english: After half an hour, Maja has three pieces home.

lines.serbian: Onda Maja izbacuje njegovu poslednju figuru.
lines.croatian: Onda Maja izbacuje njegovu posljednju figuru.
lines.english: Then Maja knocks out his last piece.

lines.serbian: – Ne! To nije fer! – viče Filip.
lines.croatian: – Ne! To nije fer! – viče Filip.

lines.serbian: – Kako se zove igra? – pita Maja.
lines.croatian: – Kako se zove igra? – pita Maja.

lines.english: Filip looks at the box and says nothing.

lines.serbian: – Čoveče, ne ljuti se – kaže tiho.
lines.croatian: – Čovječe, ne ljuti se – kaže tiho.
lines.english: "Man, don't get angry," he says quietly.
